# AI OS — The Agentic Operating System

> AI OS Orchestration Lab is an open-core, self-hosted AI operating system: a "Virtual Corporate HQ" of 68 specialized AI agents across 11 departments that routes every task across 6 AI models in 4 effort tiers (Claude Opus 5 by default, plus OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, and Perplexity). It includes an SEO + AEO agency, an AI Web Studio that designs, builds, and hosts static sites with custom domains and TLS, a Knowledge & Records governed document library, a CRM, Ed25519 content provenance, human-in-the-loop Auto-Mode approval gating, and an opt-in AI security suite. It uses a BYOK (bring your own API keys) model and is self-hosted.

Pricing: Community is free, open-source, and self-hosted; Business is $1,997 one-time; Enterprise is $4,997 one-time; the Managed Website service is $997 setup plus $250/month. Honest framing: the AEO tooling improves AI-answer-engine readiness but never guarantees citations or rankings, and the security suite is AI-assisted and report-only — a strong layer of defense, not a guarantee.

## Documentation
- [Getting Started](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/docs/getting-started): Install AI OS, configure provider API keys, and run your first agents.
- [Architecture](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/docs/architecture): The 6 AI models across 4 routing tiers, effort-based routing, and system topology.
- [Agent Fleet](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/docs/agents): The 68 specialized agents and the 11 departments they belong to.
- [Knowledge & Records](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/docs/knowledge-records): The governed company document library — a catalog over the Memory Vault, uploads, and agent artifacts, with reader-scoped access, retention, and a canonical-facts shelf every agent reads.
- [Self-Improve](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/docs/self-improve): Grok Build plans upgrades to AI OS itself and can open a draft GitHub PR — apply and PR always require explicit human approval, no auto-apply tier.
- [Client Engine](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/docs/client-engine): Google Maps local prospecting (API-based via DataForSEO or Google Places — never scraped — scored for website-upgrade fit), a Local SEO / Google Business Profile audit dimension (GBP completeness, reviews, local-pack rank) with a one-click outreach email of the audit findings, email nurture sequences (AI-drafted, human-approved, unsubscribe compliance built in), appointment booking on generated sites with .ics calendar invites, and a drag-and-drop CRM pipeline kanban with a full stage-change audit trail.
- [Analytics](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/docs/analytics): First-party, cookieless, AI-signal-first analytics — the AI crawler traffic (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) that tag-based tools can't see, per hosted site, plus answer-engine referrals.
- [Web Studio Business Tools](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/docs/web-studio-business): Lead capture into the CRM and a per-site lead inbox, sales funnels wired to your own Stripe Payment Link, dynamic pages from a dataset, and the Site Manager dashboard.
- [Agent-Ready Sites](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/docs/agent-ready-sites): The machine-readable layer every generated site ships — JSON-LD incl. FAQPage, llms.txt, Open Knowledge Format (OKF) bundles, and Ed25519-signed content provenance (C2PA-vocabulary-aligned, not certified C2PA).
- [Security](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/docs/security): The opt-in, report-only AI security suite — platform self-assessment (STRIDE + semgrep + an AI blue-team), the Web Studio publish security gate, and the managed-client security service.
- [API Reference](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/docs/api): REST endpoints with authentication, rate limits, and error codes.
- [Deployment](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/docs/deployment): PM2 + Nginx with TLS and a production hardening checklist.

## Blog
- [The Mythos-Defense Security Suite](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/blog/mythos-defense-security-suite): AI-driven, report-only security in three layers — platform self-assessment, a publish gate that scans every AI-built site before it goes live, and security as a managed-client deliverable.
- [What Is an AI Operating System?](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/blog/what-is-ai-operating-system): A complete 2026 guide to multi-model, multi-agent orchestration.
- [What Is Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)?](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/blog/what-is-answer-engine-optimization): The 8-dimension AEO readiness score, multi-model consensus, and AI-crawler allowlisting.
- [How to Automate SEO With AI Agents](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/blog/how-to-automate-seo-with-ai): From audit to action plan in 60 seconds with 5 parallel sub-agents.
- [Managed Websites, Done For You](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/blog/managed-websites-done-for-you): The $997 setup + $250/mo done-for-you hosting and maintenance service.

## Product
- [Home](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/): Platform overview, capabilities, and the 68-agent roster.
- [Pricing](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/#pricing): Community, Business, Enterprise, and the Managed Website offer.
- [About](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/about): What AI OS is, how it works, and who it's for.
- [Trust & Security](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/trust): How AI OS handles data and security — self-hosted so your data stays on your own infrastructure, the built-in controls, the shared-responsibility split, subprocessors, and an honest compliance posture (not SOC 2 certified).
- [AI Business Clone](https://aiosorchestrationlab.com/docs/business-clone): A digital replica of one person - voice, expertise, decision style and hard limits - built by interview on top of a shared company profile. Drafts for human review, can direct agents under gated limits, never sends autonomously.
